The {{Term/Store|Akkala Ancient Tech Lab||Series, BotW, TotK}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Map"/><ref name="TotK Map"/> also known as the '''Yiga Clan's Akkala Branch''',{{Exp Game|TotK}}<ref name="TotK Yiga Blademaster"/> is a recurring location in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Features and Overview==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Descriptions BotW}}
The Akkala Ancient Tech Lab is located on the [[North Akkala Foothill]] in [[Deep Akkala]]. It was converted from an abandoned lighthouse near [[East Akkala Stable]], and it currently houses [[Robbie]] and [[Jerrin]].<ref name="CaC 285"/> The pair of them operate the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab together.<ref name="BotW Jerrin"/> It is one of two successors to the [[Ancient Research Institute]], the other being the [[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]].

Following the [[Great Calamity]], Robbie and [[Purah]] discovered two sources of [[Ancient Energy]] in [[Necluda]] and [[Akkala]].<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs"/> After a game of rock, paper, scissors, it was determined that Robbie would make use of the Energy in Akkala, where he would continue his research into [[Ancient Technology]].<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 2"/> With him, he took a [[Guidance Stone]].<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 3"/> When he came upon the ruined lighthouse, he decided to settle there, turning it into the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab.<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 4"/>

At the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab, Robbie focused his research on [[Ancient Soldier Gear]].<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 5"/> The [[Ancient Furnace]] in Akkala is located on [[Tumlea Heights]], which is on the opposite side of the North Akkala Foothill.<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 6"/> In order to expedite the process of smelting [[Ancient Material]]s, Robbie refined his Guidance Stone into the [[Ancient Oven]], which he refers to as "Cherry."<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 7"/>

When Robbie was 90, [[Impa]] sent Jerrin to work at the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab.<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 8"/> She took over the duties of lighting the Lab's [[Furnace]] with the [[Blue Flame]], in addition to remodeling the Ancient Oven.<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 9"/> After some time, the two of them ended up married.<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 10"/> They had a son together, [[Granté]], who they raised at the Lab.<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 11"/> As Granté grew, he took over retrieving the Blue Flame, but he eventually left after Robbie encouraged him to travel.<ref name="BotW Robbie's Memoirs 12"/>

As part of the "[[Robbie's Research]]" [[Side Quest]], Purah tells [[Link]] to bring Ancient Materials to either her or Robbie.<ref name="BotW Purah"/> This tasks Link with finding Robbie at the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab.<ref name="BotW Adventure Log"/> When he arrives, the Furnace outside the Lab will be extinguished, and Link must reignite it in order to restore the Ancient Oven's manufacturing of Ancient Soldier Gear.<ref name="BotW Robbie"/> Once Link lights the Furnace, the [[Travel Gate]] at the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab will be activated, allowing him to [[Warping|Warp]] there directly.<ref name="BotW N/A"/> As thanks, Robbie gives Link three [[Ancient Arrow]]s.<ref name="BotW Robbie 2"/> Following this, Link will be able to purchase Ancient Soldier Gear and the [[Ancient Set]] from the Ancient Oven, in exchange for [[Rupee]]s and Ancient Materials.<ref name="BotW Robbie 3"/>

When Link speaks to Jerrin at the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab, she informs him that through her research, she has discovered an [[Ancient Shrine]] on the left eye of [[Skull Lake]].<ref name="BotW Jerrin 2"/> This begins "[[The Skull's Eye]]" [[Shrine Quest]]. If Link returns to Jerrin after locating [[Zuna Kai Shrine]], she is unable to give him a reward due to the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab being short on funding.<ref name="BotW Jerrin 3"/><ref name="BotW Jerrin 4"/>
